name: io.github.Pushary/pushary
title: Pushary
description: Reach a human from a running agent. Ask before an irreversible action, when a decision is outside the agent's authority, or when a long task finishes with nobody watching, and get the answer back from the user's lock screen. Every question and answer is recorded, and one account covers Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf and Hermes alike.
